card.name: The letter W starting warn- or war- words
card.fires_on: A lone W or w that begins a word such as Warnings, warming, wobble or wear, mostly right after 'see' in label cross-references. The word is split so the W stands alone.

modes.label: W starting other words
modes.description: A split-off w that begins words like warming, wobble or wear in general text.
